title: Console observability blind spots discovered in capacity/regression incident — postmortem & action plan
creator: Emma Chen
description:
Summary:
During a capacity/regression event on 2026-02-25 traffic shifts exposed multiple observability blind spots in the Redwood Console. Users experienced delayed diagnosis because key telemetry was missing or aggregated incorrectly and traces for internal worker paths were not sampled. The postmortem identified three classes of gaps: missing metrics (per-route tail latency, KV cache hit/miss, batching distribution), dashboard anti-patterns (hidden filters, wrong aggregation windows), and tracing coverage/sampling gaps (background workers, RPC fan-out).

RCA (high level):
1) A telemetry ingestion rename in runtime-1.18 changed metric labels (service->route_name) which broke the mapping used by several Console dashboards and alert rules. The ingestion pipeline didn't generate an error; metrics were silently dropped.
2) Several dashboards used 1h rollup windows by default and binary 'sum' aggregations which masked tail spikes.
3) Tracing sampling policy excluded background goroutines handling batch coalescing due to an off-by-one in the tracer initialization path introduced in ENG-8789.

Impact: slowed incident mitigation and increased mean time to recovery by ~27 minutes on average. Affected internal and enterprise customers relying on Console dashboards and alerts for capacity planning and escalation.

Goal for this ticket: track, implement, and verify postmortem action items to plug blind spots and prevent recurrence. Deliverables include: corrected ingestion mappings, dashboard revisions, sampling fixes, alert tuning, integration tests for telemetry renames, and a follow-up audit plan.
action_items: INGEST-1: Add compatibility layer in telemetry ingestion to accept both old and new label names (service, route_name). Owner: Mateo Alvarez. Due: 2026-03-10. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/312

DASH-1: Audit top 12 Console dashboards for aggregation/window anti-patterns. Replace 1h rollups with 1m/5m as appropriate and add explicit tail-percentile (p95/p99) panels. Owner: Oliver Park. Due: 2026-03-18. Link: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/console/top-dashboards

TRACE-1: Fix tracer initialization bug skipping background worker spans (ENG-8789 regression). Add unit tests to ensure sampling policy includes background workers. Owner: Priya Singh. Due: 2026-03-08. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789
ALERT-1: Update alert rules to use per-route p99 latency and add detection for sudden metric disappearance (missing series alert). Owner: SRE Team (ENG-8841). Due: 2026-03-12.

TEST-1: Create e2e test in CI that performs a simulated metric rename and verifies console dashboards and alerting continue to surface expected series. Owner: QA (ENG-8912). Due: 2026-03-20. CI job: https://ci.redwood.com/telemetry/rename-compat

DOC-1: Confluence postmortem + runbook update: include checklist for telemetry rename events and dashboard ownership. Owner: Emma Chen. Due: 2026-03-05. Doc: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Console+Telemetry+Postmortem
AUDIT-1: Quarterly observability audit backlog item to add synthetic checks for KV cache hit rate and batch size distribution in Console. Owner: Observability PM. Due: 2026-04-15.
